findings.description: An issue link carrying a trailing slash, fragment or query named no issue, so a cross-repository #N fell back to the row's own repository; a #N linking no issue did the same silently.
No deps test pinned a cross-repository number mismatch.
deps.py compared a #N entry's number with its link as strings, so #09 linking issue 9 was reported.
deps.py's usage line still called #750 not checked.
board.py's module docstring left a 107-character line and mixed a relative clause into a participle list.
Two test_deps lines ran past the module width.
deps.py passed a #N entry linking no issue, which board.py refuses.
board.py ISSUE_URL rejected the suffixed issue-link form ISSUE_REF accepts.
deps.py read an issue link on any host, where board.py reads a github.com owner/repo link alone.
